Question: Let \(S\) be the set of all points \((x, y)\) in the coordinate plane such that \(0 \le x \le \dfrac{\pi}{2}\) and \(0 \le y \le \dfrac{\pi}{2}.\) What is the area of the subset of \(S\) for which \[\sin^2 x - \sin x \sin y + \sin^2 y \le \frac{3}{4}?\]
